title: The Lost Lantern Locket
intro: A silver locket with a tiny glowing lantern charm has vanished from the lost-property desk at Harbor Street station, just minutes before its owner came to collect it.

suspects.name: Wren
suspects.line: Sketching the platform clock all morning. Check my sketchbook.

suspects.name: Otis
suspects.line: I was napping on the bench by the clock. Ask the pigeons.

suspects.name: Rafe
suspects.line: I never touch lost things. Bad luck, everyone knows that.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I only went near the desk to ask about my umbrella.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: My hands? Spotless, I promise. I just came for the 8:15.

clues.text: Fresh fingerprints on the lost-property desk show the culprit was last seen standing right there, beside the open drawer.
A sticky sparkling lemonade cup was found by the snack cart, and its fizzy trail leads straight to the suspect's drink choice.
The waiting bench still holds a neat pile of umbrellas, and the culprit is not the person who sat there, since the bench cushion stayed perfectly dry and unwrinkled.
Hot cocoa spill marks dot the kettle corner, but the culprit is not the one who ordered cocoa, as the barista swears no cocoa was poured.
